name: FreeConferenceCall.com
description_en:
FreeConferenceCall.com provides hosted audio/video conferencing, screen sharing and meeting collaboration. It is a separate product from FreeConference.com; their limits and paid add-ons must not be exchanged.

The official pricing page advertises a free meeting plan and optional paid calling/branding/storage features. Free service access does not establish that a participant’s telephone carrier or every toll-free call is cost-free.
description_zh:
FreeConferenceCall.com 提供托管音视频会议、屏幕共享及会议协作，与 FreeConference.com 是不同产品，不能交换两者限制及付费附加项。

官方价格页宣传免费会议方案及可选的号码、品牌和存储付费功能。服务免费不代表参与者运营商或所有免费拨入号码都不产生费用。

core_features.explanation_en: Hosted meetings include video, screen/document sharing and meeting chat in the free plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费托管会议列有视频、屏幕/文档共享及会议聊天。

core_features.explanation_en: One Number changes dial-in access; Pro Bundle includes expanded cloud storage and greeting/music features.
core_features.explanation_zh: One Number 改变拨入方式，Pro Bundle 包含扩展云存储及问候/音乐功能。

sections.en:
An organizer can evaluate a hosted meeting with a shared invitation, phone/browser/app access and participant controls. The pricing page lists muting, meeting locking and roles. Before inviting the group, rehearse a participant join, screen share and recording retrieval; clarify who may host, see files and access recordings. These are proposed checks, not a session executed here.

The pricing card says 1,000 call participants and unlimited meeting time, while home-page video copy says unlimited video participants. Do not turn the latter slogan into an independently established unlimited concurrent-video capacity. Confirm the intended meeting size and participant path.
sections.zh:
组织者可评估共享邀请、电话/浏览器/应用加入及参与者控制的托管会议。价格页列有静音、锁定及角色。邀请小组前，应演练加入、屏幕共享和录制取回，并明确谁可主持、查看文件及录制；这些是拟议检查，本次未执行会话。

价格卡写 1,000 位通话参与者及不限会议时长，而首页视频文案写视频参与者不限。不能把后者宣传转成独立确认的无限并发视频容量，需确认实际规模及加入路径。

sections.title_en: Optional upgrades have different billing units
sections.title_zh: 附加项具有不同计费单位
sections.en:
The read pricing page had annual billing selected: Free showed $0/month with 1 GB cloud storage, One Number $39/year, and Pro Bundle $79/year. One Number offers a private conference number without a participant access code and host recognition/first-caller notifications. Pro adds custom greeting/hold music and a card saying 10 GB cloud storage. Another section calls this an additional 10 GB, leaving the exact total storage entitlement to confirm.

Toll-free numbers show $0.02 per minute per caller; 20 callers connected for 30 minutes would represent 600 caller-minutes before any contract-specific rules, an illustrative arithmetic example only. Custom greeting and hold music separately show $2/month each. The captured page did not explicitly establish currency code, taxes, carrier charges or monthly-mode upgrade prices, so those are not normalized.
sections.zh:
实读价格页选择年度计费：Free 显示每月 $0、1 GB 云存储，One Number 每年 $39，Pro Bundle 每年 $79。One Number 提供参与者无需接入码的专用会议号码，以及主持识别/首位呼入通知。Pro 增加定制问候/等候音乐，卡片写 10 GB 云存储，另一节称额外 10 GB，准确总额度需确认。

免费拨入号码标每呼叫者每分钟 $0.02，20 人各接入 30 分钟为 600 呼叫者分钟，再适用具体合同规则；这只是计算示例。定制问候和等候音乐单独各标每月 $2。截取页未明确币种代码、税费、运营商收费或月付模式升级价，因此不作标准化。

sections.title_en: Validate access and support before relying on free hosting
sections.title_zh: 依赖免费托管前验证准入与支持
sections.en:
Budget-conscious groups can evaluate the free plan with its stated storage allowance; organizers needing a branded dial-in or more storage should compare specific upgrades instead of buying a generic per-seat plan. No public self-hosting or open-source licence was established.

The support link redirected in this browser to /zh/gb/support and displayed an internal-server-error notice. Detailed current support procedures therefore remain unverified. No call, purchase, carrier bill, storage retention, host authentication, encryption configuration or recovery test was performed. Recording availability is not a promise of indefinite retention.
sections.zh:
预算有限的小组可结合已列存储额度评估免费方案；需要品牌拨入或更大存储的组织者，应比较具体附加项，不能套用通用每席位套餐。未确立公共自托管或开源许可。

支持链接在本次浏览器跳转到 /zh/gb/support 并显示服务器内部错误，当前详细支持流程因此未核实。未进行通话、购买、运营商账单、存储保留、主持认证、加密配置或恢复测试。有录制功能不保证无限期保留。
